name: aad-restrict-groupnesting
title: Restricting Group Nesting in Microsoft Entra ID Using Graph API
shortDescription: Create a Microsoft Entra security group that does not allow other groups to be added as members, using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
longDescription: Creates a Microsoft Entra security group with the disableNesting property enabled through the Microsoft Graph beta API, preventing other groups from being added as its members.
